reasoning_traces.think:
Optimal calibration requires balancing three error sources. Uncertainty is fixed by data distribution; reducing resolution demands extreme predictions, while improving reliability necessitates conservative estimates. The gap between resolution and reliability must widen significantly (6-10x) to reach the floor of 0.22. Practical methods include selective publishing to enforce extremeness and online model combination to lower variance.
